articles.title: PM Modi Shares BRICS Reel: India’s Big Moment Ahead Of Summit | New Global Order? | News18
articles.description: PM Narendra Modi has shared a new Instagram reel ahead of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, highlighting India’s leadership of the grouping as the country prepares to host some of the world’s most powerful leaders.India is currently holding the BRICS chairmanship for 2026, with the summit scheduled for September 12–13 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. The Indian presidency is built around the themes of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability.The reel comes at a crucial geopolitical moment. Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to visit India for the first time in seven years, while Russian President Vladimir Putin is also due in New Delhi. Modi is expected to hold key bilateral discussions with both leaders on the sidelines of the summit.BRICS is also facing major challenges. The ongoing Iran conflict has exposed divisions within the expanded grouping, particularly between Iran and the UAE. India will have to work to build consensus while presenting BRICS as a stronger voice for the Global South. n18oc_indiaNews18 Mobile App - https://onelink.to/desc-youtube
